csv_fields.name: name
csv_fields.description: Current credential name recorded by RoleMath.

csv_fields.name: route_identifier
csv_fields.description: Stable RoleMath route-shaped identifier; it is not a promise that a live page exists.

csv_fields.name: rolemath_url
csv_fields.description: Absolute live RoleMath URL only when an authoritative live-route set is supplied; otherwise blank.

csv_fields.name: currentness_state
csv_fields.description: current, stale, or unresolved as of the record's checked evidence.

csv_fields.name: current_exam_code
csv_fields.description: Current attributable exam code when the vendor publishes one.

csv_fields.name: current_version
csv_fields.description: Current attributable version label or explicit vendor-no-number posture.

csv_fields.name: current_source_url
csv_fields.description: First-party source for current credential identity.

csv_fields.name: current_checked_date
csv_fields.description: Date RoleMath checked the currentness source.

csv_fields.name: exam_fees_json
csv_fields.description: JSON array of scoped fee observations with source and checked date.

csv_fields.name: renewal_json
csv_fields.description: JSON renewal/lifecycle object, or null when not attributable.

csv_fields.name: occupation_ids
csv_fields.description: Semicolon-delimited occupation identifiers for the published contexts.

csv_fields.name: training_offer_count
csv_fields.description: Count of dated provider-owned training observations in the JSON record.

csv_fields.name: known_unknowns_json
csv_fields.description: JSON array of explicit unresolved public-fact fields.

limitations: Occupation statistics describe the mapped occupation, not certification holders, and do not prove that this credential causes a salary, hiring, or employment outcome.
Training offers are dated observations, not availability, willingness, relationship, or provider completeness claims.
Route identifiers do not imply that a live RoleMath page exists; rolemath_url remains null unless an authoritative live-route set is supplied.
A non-null rolemath_url means the exact route appeared in the 310-URL RoleMath sitemap observed on 2026-08-10; it is not an indexing or traffic claim.

live_url_projection.method: Exact normalized route match only; no fuzzy matching or held-route inference.
